breeding.method: S3 feminized photoperiod (official Humboldt Seed Company designation)

lineage.note: Exact parentals and S3 designation are taken from Humboldt Seed Company's current feminized California Octane product page.

aromas.note: Official product page describes a strong gas nose with hints of guava and crème.

terpenes.note: The official Humboldt Seed Company product page gives aroma/flavor descriptors but no compound-level terpene profile. Third-party terpene claims were not promoted to the candidate record.

origin.note: Humboldt Seed Company is based in Humboldt County, California, but the reviewed official product page does not explicitly establish the cultivar's place of origin. Company location is not treated as cultivar origin.

history.note: The official product page labels California Octane an original strain and provides parentals/S3 status, but the reviewed primary sources do not provide a dated cultivar-development history. No history is inferred.
